_comment: StepFun StepAudio 2.5 system voices available to the CodeToCost channel. Source of truth: https://platform.stepfun.ai/docs/en/api-reference/audio/system-voices (GET https://api.stepfun.ai/v1/audio/system_voices?model=stepaudio-2.5-tts). 'english: true' marks the voices purpose-built for the English B2B channel.

voices.name: Magnetic-voiced Male
voices.description: Deep, magnetic male voice (English); strong calm and weight.
voices.notes: Analytical and technical; the deepest option for a senior-engineer narrator.

voices.name: Soft-spoken Gentleman
voices.description: Calm, gentle male voice (English); reassuring and steady.
voices.notes: Official channel voice. Softer and more intimate; good for explainers.

voices.name: Vibrant Youth
voices.notes: Approachable and energetic; reads acronyms faster but loses gravitas.

voices.name: Lively Girl
voices.description: Bright, lively female voice (English); personable and energetic.
voices.notes: Only female English system voice; usable for channel variation, less on-brand for the analyst persona.

voices.name: Confident Male
voices.description: Confident male voice; sincere, warm, energetic.
voices.notes: Mandarin-tuned system voice; kept as a fallback only.

voices.name: Elegant, gentle female
voices.notes: Mandarin-tuned system voice; kept as a fallback only.

voices.name: Light, breezy female
voices.notes: Mandarin-tuned system voice; kept as a fallback only.
